first.name: Levium
sentences: How curious... I was not aware we were to be expecting guests. The timing of this can't possibly be a coincidence however.
Gaia, the mother of all life, has recently been captured and locked away in Mystic Towers. She must have sent you to help.
I'm surprised she was able to conjour up a new Guardian. We thought she'd used up all of her Essence, but clearly that's not the case.
I suppose a welcome is in order. This is Cosmic Core, one of many links to the worlds across the stars, and it is home to us Wingrays, as well as... Dolus.
He's been conveniently absent since Gaia's disappearance. I suspect he might have something to do with it all...
Anyway, I'm not sure what you can do at this point, or what anyone can. I suppose all we can do is wait.
